_comment: Copy this file to local.settings.json and fill in real values. local.settings.json is gitignored.

Values._comment_storage: TWO storage connections. AzureWebJobsStorage = Functions HOST plumbing only (blob-trigger receipts, internal control queues, host leases). Locally use the Azurite emulator (UseDevelopmentStorage=true); in Azure set this to the Function App's DEFAULT storage account connection string. SyncStorage = the DATA account: the blob-trigger source (cdm-landing container), the dead-letter queue (producer + QueueTrigger consumer), and the failure blob archive. Identity-based via DefaultAzureCredential — grant 'Storage Blob Data Contributor' + 'Storage Queue Data Contributor' on this account. AZURE_TOKEN_CREDENTIALS=dev restricts the Functions host's credential chain to non-IMDS developer credentials (az login, VS sign-in) locally so it doesn't probe an IMDS endpoint that doesn't exist on a dev box.
Values._comment_source: Data source is now a blob-triggered Excel workbook, not SQL. Drop a CDM snapshot .xlsx into the 'cdm-landing' container on the SyncStorage account and the CdmDataverseSync function fires automatically. The header row's column names must match the SQL projection 1:1 (MTH_KEY, ACCT_NUM, ACCT_ID, ACCT_KEY, Balance, ChargeOffIndicator, CostCenter, CustomerName, CollAddr, CollCity, CollState, CollZip, CustStreetAddress, CustCity, CustState, CustZip, LoanIdentifier, SourceSystem, Product).
Values._comment_prewarm: PreWarmParallelism = concurrent Dataverse lookup queries per module during pre-warm. Pre-warm failure is per-module and isolated: a module whose pre-warm fails is skipped for this file (it is NOT processed in Phase 4). Modules whose pre-warm succeeds proceed to update normally. The whole sync only aborts when EVERY module's pre-warm fails.
Values._comment_deadletter: Storage Queue buffers failed records before they're written to the Dataverse error table. The QueueTrigger listener for DeadLetterProcessor binds to SyncStorage (not AzureWebJobsStorage), so the queue must live on the same account SyncStorage__queueServiceUri points to. DeadLetterMaxAttempts is NOT set here — Program.cs reads extensions.queues.maxDequeueCount from host.json so the two can't drift.
Values._comment_failureblob: When all queue retries are exhausted, one blob per record is archived under errors/yyyy/MM/dd/{invocationId}-{key}.json. Same storage account as the queue.
Values._comment_disable: Set to 'true' to disable the DeadLetterProcessor QueueTrigger function. Use when the queue doesn't exist yet or storage RBAC is being sorted — a failed listener startup otherwise kills the entire host (incl. the TimerTrigger).
Values._comment_appinsights: Optional. When unset the app runs fine and telemetry is discarded. Set it to start seeing traces/dependencies/exceptions in the Application Insights resource. Format: InstrumentationKey=<guid>;IngestionEndpoint=https://<region>.applicationinsights.azure.com/;...
